title: Senior Product Designer, Platform (Geospatial)
announcement: Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth. Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one. Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles. As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains. We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world. Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands. About the Role:   The design team at Planet is looking for a Senior Product Designer to shape Planet's platform experience (insights.planet.com - free trial available). In this role, you will be responsible for defining the core user journeys across our platform, addressing the needs of different user types (from admins, to developers, to end users). With a relentless focus on those users, you will define jobs-to-be-done and design end-to-end user flows across web frontends and agentic workflows. You will collaborate closely with Product and Engineering to decompose these workflows into scalable, reusable UX building blocks, ultimately crafting a cohesive, user-centric platform experience. The perfect candidate brings a track record of designing sophisticated, data-heavy geospatial applications. This role is full stack, in the design sense: you take a problem from discovery with users all the way to designing and building the interfaces, side by side with our engineers.  This is a full-time, hybrid role which will require you to work from our Berlin or Haarlem office 3 days per week. Impact You’ll Own: Product Design Ownership: Lead the end-to-end process from discovery and prototyping to high-fidelity design. Geospatial Interface Design: Create intuitive, powerful geospatial interfaces that translate complex data into actionable insights.  User Research: Gather feedback and conduct user interviews in close collaboration with product partners. UI Architecture: Define and architect the interaction patterns and design system for Planet’s platform. Cross-functional Collaboration: Partner with product and engineering to ensure top-tier design quality. Culture: Help build and elevate Planet's design culture. What You Bring: 6+ years designing complex digital products, with a track record of shipping technical, SaaS, or B2B software end to end.  Bachelor’s degree in design or an equivalent field. A portfolio with geospatial or data analytics work: interactive maps, layered geospatial data and time series (time sliders, change over time, comparisons), plus the statistics and charts that turn data into an insight.  Solid core craft in UX/UI, interaction design, prototyping, accessibility, and visual design, plus Figma and enterprise design systems. An AI-native way of working. You can prototype in code with AI coding assistants, and you're comfortable with Git and merge requests.  Research you run yourself: user interviews and usability testing, synthesized into clear product direction. Comfort with ambiguity. You take vague, complex problems and drive them to a validated solution without daily oversight. A dynamic, iterative, low-ego way of working with PMs, engineers, and other designers. What Makes You Stand Out: Experience designing for developers, data scientists, or AI agents. Hands-on with remote sensing analysis and familiarity with geospatial standards. You enjoy meeting customers and are open to travel within Europe. Experience helping a team adopt new ways of working. Application Deadline: 11:45p / 23:45 CET on the date stated below. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. This posting may be removed earlier than projected if a suitable pool of applications has been received. For this reason, we recommend applying as soon as you are able to. Benefits While Working at Planet: These offerings are dependent on employment type and geographical location, based upon applicable law or company policy. Paid time off including vacation, holidays and company-wide days off  Employee Wellness Program  Home Office Reimbursement Monthly Phone and Internet Reimbursement Tuition Reimbursement and access to LinkedIn Learning Equity  Volunteering Paid Time Off Compensation: The expected starting gross salary range for this role is listed below. This position may also be eligible for discretionary bonuses and/or equity. Germany Salary Range €77.000 — €96.300 EUR San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Why we care so much about Belonging.  We’re dedicated to helping the whole Planet, and to do that we must strive to represent all of it within each of our offices and on all of our teams. That’s why Planet is guided by an ultimate north star of Belonging—dreaming big as we approach our ongoing work.  If this job intrigues you, but you’re thinking you might not have all the qualifications, please... do apply!  At Planet, we are looking for well-rounded people from around the world who can contribute to more ways than just what is listed in this job description.  We don’t just fill positions, we aspire to fulfill people’s careers, most excited about folks who are motivated by our underlying humanitarian efforts.  We are a few orbits around the sun before we get to where we want to be, so we hope you’re excited to come along for the ride.  EEO statement: Planet is committed to building a community where everyone belongs and we invite people from all backgrounds to apply.
